output.summary: The group's roughly 17.6 minute ticket time outside Riverside dates to the October 2024 scratch menu redesign. The board knowingly accepted it, and the 12-minute benchmark panel excludes scratch kitchens. Guest satisfaction, food quality, repeat visits, check size and same-store sales all improved since then. Riverside is a separate local problem. Its saute/pasta cook left in August, the vacancy has gone unfilled, and group operations deferred two transfer requests. Riverside's problem lies in KDS station timings and a complaint rate that rose from 0.7% to 4.6%. The reason Delgado left is disputed and unresolved. Restore Riverside staffing, reframe the benchmark, and avoid frozen conversion, GM replacement and a 12-minute bonus (the earlier 2023 incentive scheme led to gaming of the KDS bump).
